Drive until the rod reads HI − formation level; stake top then marks the grade.
Blue line = formation, red line = ground; fill if blue above red, cut if below.
Short stakes = cut, long stakes = fill; C 8 / F 12; fills 10–15% extra for settling.
Start at the outlet; stakes every 15 m (7.5 m on sharp turns); rise = grade × 15 m.
